title: eval-harness: add CI hooks and metrics integration for prompt-set regression gating
author: Priya Menon
description: Add CI hooks and metrics integration to the eval-harness to enable automated prompt-set regression gating in PRs. Motivation: prevent accidental quality regressions when changing prompts, model variants, or preprocessing by running a lightweight eval set as part of CI and publishing metrics to the metrics pipeline so alerts and gating rules can be enforced. This PR introduces: 1) a new GH Actions workflow (infra/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml) that runs a quick prompt regression eval on changed prompt-sets; 2) a small runtime hook (eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression.py) that selects affected prompt tests and runs them in a mocked-fast mode to bound CI time; 3) metrics exporter (eval-harness/ci/metrics/exporter.py) to publish summary statistics (pass_rate, delta_auc, avg_bleu) to the internal metrics pipeline via the existing metrics client; 4) test coverage and flakiness controls (tests/eval/test_prompt_regressions.py and tests/eval/fixtures/*). The description below covers design decisions, compatibility, and the rollout plan. Design: the hook detects changed files under eval-harness/prompts/ and maps them to prompt sets configured in eval-registry.yaml. The CI workflow runs on PRs and schedules a parallelized run with a 10 minute timeout; results are uploaded as an artifact and the metrics exporter posts a summary metric set to metrics-service under tag "eval.prompt_regression.pr". To avoid noisy alerts, we use a three-tier gate: fail PR when pass_rate drops by >5% AND absolute pass_rate < 90%; create a warning annotation otherwise. Backwards compatibility: when eval-registry.yaml is missing the hook falls back to running the full quick-suite; this preserves behavior for older repos. Test plan: unit tests for the exporter, integration tests that run a mocked model for prompt sets, and an e2e dry run on a staging workflow. Rollout: feature flagged under eval_ci.prompt_regression_enabled and rollout to Redwood repo only for two weeks before enabling org-wide. Checklist: implemented workflow, hook, exporter, tests, docs update (docs/ci.md), added Linear links and alerts.
